description: This file defines a configuration class for an OpenAI-like chat completion transformer. It includes methods for handling provider info, converting tool responses to messages, sanitizing response objects, transforming API responses, and mapping parameters. It appears to be part of a larger framework for handling language model API interactions.

classes.name: OpenAILikeChatConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for an OpenAI-like chat system, extending OpenAIGPTConfig with additional methods for handling API provider info, response transformation, and parameter mapping.
